row.evidence: Skilljar documents only SAML 2.0 for Dashboard SSO ('you will have the option to invite new Dashboard users and set them to authenticate through this SSO Configuration'); its help centre has no SCIM articles and the Okta and Entra apps are SSO/JIT only.
row.notes: Quote-only pricing: annual plan (Essentials, Professional, Enterprise) plus an active-learner fee. SSO for Learners and the REST API are on Essentials; SSO for Admins (Dashboard SAML, set up via Support) from Professional. Dashboard users are invited and deleted manually; no SCIM. The REST API (HTTP Basic API key) manages learners, groups and enrollments, not dashboard admins. Okta/Entra gallery apps provide SAML with JIT for training sites only. None by absence.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.price_text: Let's talk pricing (annual subscription + active-user fee)
plans.notes: Includes SSO for Learners and the REST API; SSO for Admins (dashboard SAML) is listed from Professional.

endpoints.purpose: List users with access to a training domain
Create a user / grant domain access
Add a user to a group
Remove a user from a group
Create a webhook (course/path/domain enrollment and completion events)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks cover learner enrollment/completion events, not user lifecycle.

limitations.text: The API's users are students (learners) on training domains; no endpoints for Skilljar Dashboard (admin) users were found.

okta.notes: OIN app is SAML-only (JIT 'enhanced provisioning' of learners via SAML attributes); built for training domains, not the admin dashboard.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO + JIT for training domains.

fallbacks.other_sync: Learner accounts via REST API, token-based SSO, OAuth 2.0/OIDC SSO
fallbacks.notes: JIT applies to learners on training sites; Dashboard (admin) users must be invited, then can be set to authenticate via SAML.
